notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Completion percentages on the title screen and campaign selector now display two decimal places for better clarity.
[*] The floating tiles background resolution has been adjusted to match the rest of the game.
[*] The cluster editor window now properly scales to fit the screen height.
[*] Colored Inductive Interfaces must now be powered up to progress to the next segment.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Cluster 2 "PSU": Fixed an issue where two bottom blue nodes incorrectly triggered the "relock warning" when disconnected.
[*] Cluster 4 "5": A new stage has been added to teach a mechanic essential for later gameplay.
[*] Cluster 5 "Booter": Completing this stage now unlocks the next cluster without requiring all stages in the cluster to be finished.
[*] Cluster 6 "3-B": Adjusted a specific trick to make it easier to spot.
[*] Cluster 3 "Booter": Fixed a layout issue that could cause players to get stuck, requiring a restart.
[*] Powering up an electrode during the boss battle now reduces the timer (only once per electrode per layer).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Music that loops now resumes correctly when pausing and unpausing (e.g., during playtests in the editor or when switching stages).
[*] Pressing "L" while renaming a stage no longer closes the underlying window.
[*] The Steam Overlay now works properly on Windows (may reintroduce "ghost windows" issues).
[*] The campaign editor can now be closed even if no campaign is loaded.
[*] Fixed an issue where holding erase on a one-tile-long path wouldn’t trigger extrication (e.g., when directly connected to a node).
[*] Using the "Set Segment Unlock" and "Set Segment Depth" tools in the editor now marks the campaign as modified, prompting a save.
[*] Fixed Polish characters in bold fonts causing spacing issues.
[*] Text in the "Reset Progress" window now updates properly when the language is changed.
[*] Fixed incorrect translations in the Credits.
[*] Localizers have been added to the Credits.
[*] Resolved a bug in the editor where using the erase button with the Drag/Resize tool could crash the game.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: It’s finally here – the full version of Trans Neuronica!
notes.notes:
[h3]Ready to make some connections? 🤖✨


In Trans Neuronica, it’s all about linking nodes and unraveling the relationship between humans and AI. Tackle mind-bending puzzles, face off against bosses, and make choices that shape the story. [/h3]

[previewyoutube=C4IHJDCZ-6E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Can you handle the truth? 💡⚡
Play the full version of Trans Neurotica now and test your mind![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390520/Trans_Neuronica/ 
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Full Version / Patch 1.0.5 changelog:[/b][/h3]

[u][b]FEATURES:[/b][/u]
Campaign selection and the editor were added
Achievements were added
Colored Inductive Interfaces element was added
35 new stages were added to the main campaign
The "Prelude" campaign was bundled with the game
Cluster 2 boss stage was reworked to make it impossible to get stuck
Almost all animations, cutscenes, dialogues and other time-consuming effects can now be skipped/severely sped up
The game no longer takes 1+ minute to start on Linux
Added Chinese language
Added an option that prevents accidentally mixing colors as it has no positive gameplay effect

[u][b]NOTABLE FIXES:[/b][/u]
Full screen and maximized state of the window is now remembered between the play sessions
EM Circuits are now only affected by powered paths
A lot of tweaks, small fixes and adjustments across many stages
Making a mistake on any boss's last layer no longer softlocks the game
In certain cases some buttons had a clickable area near the top-left corner of the game area
Game now auto saves when a node gets connected/disconnected to avoid losing progress

[u][b]SMALL FIXES:[/b][/u]
Restarting a completed boss now correctly clears the "Booter Fixed" message from the screen
Unfinished stages have a visual effect on the map which makes them easier to spot
When paths blink because they are connected/disconnected, the effect extends to new paths drawn while it's still playing

notes.title: Trans Neuronica - New update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey!
The new update is now LIVE and available to download to everyone!
Here's the changelog so you can stay up to date with the news:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950777/b61c577d927cbb46e091c01599c7b63049ce5644.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Polish language was added.
[*] Added option to change Scaling Mode to better support different resolutions
[*] Added option to change the style of gamepad buttons used by the game
[*] Added a notice on completed boss stages so it's obvious what's going on
[*] Improved undoing from mistakes in boss stages and when breaking segments - instead of undoing the entirety of the last draw it will only undo as much as required to prevent the mistake (technically: it'll undo the draws from the last frame update)
[*] Redesigned parts of "Peripherals Interface Booter" where it was possible to get permanently stuck on one step depending on how you solved a previous one
[*] 10 new stages and various tweaks to a bunch of existing stages
[*] A lot of small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Trans Neuronica update + Cerebral Puzzle Showcase Special!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Test Subjects![/h1]

[b]Trans Neuronica[/b] has now been updated to version 0.4.8 that comes with a slew of new levels, features, bugfixes and improvements. All in time to take part in the celebration of games that require thinking more than anything else - the 2023 [b]CEREBRAL PUZZLE SHOWCASE![/b]

To mark the occasion, the game is now available 50% OFF, only until Monday, August 7th. Make sure to grab it now, and connect those nodes like they're hot! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390520/Trans_Neuronica

And if you're a returning player, you're probably wondering about the...

[h2]Trans Neuronica 0.4.8 Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level selection
[*] 15 new levels (including a new boss stage)
[*] New prompt appears after clearing a stage asking whether to continue or stay
[*] New prompt appears before section relocking happens, showing preview of the consequences and giving the option to cancel it
[*] Greedy path erasing mode (enabled by default) that does not require moving along a path to remove it
[*] Story was adjusted to new level selection and new boss being available
[*] A button to reset the story appears on the title screen once the main campaign is completed to allow exploring different branches of the narrative
[/list]
 
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hud was reworked to make it less annoying to use
[*] Background movement has been reduced and steadied to make it less nauseating
[*] Different window animation effect
[*] Some levels were updated to prevent unintended solutions or cheesing
[*] Terminology changes: Remove (in the context of removing paths) is now called Erase
[*] Terminology changes: Modules and Components (as referring to ingame levels) are now called Stages
[*] Terminology changes: Power Cells are now called Electrodes
[*] Logging game session to file was added to improve debugging
[*] Logos across the game appear in high resolution
[/list]
 
[h3]Accessibility:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Background brightness and animation speed is now customizable
[*] Boss timer can be slowed down and disabled
[*] Toggle draw mode, where pressing the relevant key will toggle between drawing/erasing being enabled or not
[*] Node disconnected visual effect is calmer and less nauseating 
[/list]
 
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Phantom windows no longer should appear when alt-tabbing from the game
[*] Bare modifier keys are no longer mappable, making it possible to map actions to bigger variety of special characters
[*] Key presses are now registered even if they are released before a single frame passes
[*] When a section relock causes single tile paths to remain they are now automatically removed
[*] Various small issues with focus not behaving intuitively in menus when using keyboard/gamepad were fixed
[*] It should no longer be possible to have two buttons appear as focused by using keyboard/gamepad and slightly nudging the mouse
[*] Fixed incorrect XBox button name from "Ch. View" to "View"
[/list]

Ready? Fire up those neurons, and dive into some deceptively colorful puzzle gameplay. More to come, so see you soon!

[h3]Yours,[/h3]
[h2]Evidently Cube & Hyperstrange[/h2]
